item.title: Meta Is in Crisis, Google Search’s Makeover, and AI Gets Booed by Graduates
item.description: In this episode of Uncanny Valley, we unpack the mass layoffs at Meta, big announcements at Google I/O, and the latest backlash against AI.

item.title: I Cloned Myself With Gemini’s AI Avatar Tool. The Result Was Unnervingly Me
item.description: I used the Gemini app to generate lifelike videos featuring a digital clone of myself. Google sees this as the future of creation. I’m still creeped out.

item.title: SpaceX Listed Grok’s ‘Spicy’ Mode as a Risk in Its IPO Filing
item.description: The rocket company has set aside more than $500 million for potential litigation losses, in part to account for complaints alleging that Grok created sexualized images.

item.title: SpaceX Is Spending $2.8 Billion to Buy Gas Turbines for Its AI Data Centers
item.description: The investment comes as Elon Musk’s AI unit faces complaints about the carbon-emitting units and looks to become a big player in cloud computing.

item.title: I Gave My OpenClaw Agent a Physical Body
item.description: The coding skills of AI models are about to make it much easier to build and deploy robots.

item.title: Literary Prizewinners Are Facing AI Allegations. It Feels Like the New Normal
item.description: Three of five regional winners of the prestigious Commonwealth Short Story Prize are suspected of relying on chatbots. They’re certainly not alone.

item.title: Everything Announced at Google I/O 2026: Gemini, Search, Smart Glasses
item.description: Google is sprucing up its Gemini models, revamping search, and enabling AI agents in everything. There are also some spiffy new smart glasses coming this fall.

item.title: Meta Employees Are Scrambling to Use Up Benefits Ahead of Layoffs
item.description: On the eve of about 8,000 jobs being cut, employees are cashing in on headphone stipends and other perks while they still can.

item.title: Demis Hassabis Thinks AI Job Cuts Are Dumb
item.description: The CEO of Google DeepMind tells WIRED that companies should use the productivity gains of AI to do more, not lay people off.

item.title: Google Makes It Easy to Deepfake Yourself
item.description: Google’s overhaul of its AI creation software, Flow, includes a new video model and a tool for generating selfie videos called avatars.
